title: SS28 Girls' Little Crafts
summary: Handmade summer for children: crochet, embroidery and straw, in peach and linen.
research_period: SS28 previews published November 2025 to November 2026; SS27 runway record

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Long-range projection. SS28 kidswear fairs (Pitti Bimbo and Playtime) take place in June 2027. This report projects from SS28 adult previews, the SS27 kidswear fair record and long-term drivers such as heat and UV protection, and will be updated after the fairs.

sections.heading: The story
sections.body: Milano Unica's SS28 "Enrichment" principle: handcrafted techniques and detail <sup>[1]</sup>; Future Snoops' SS27 Happenstance celebrated playful, child-led design <sup>[2]</sup>.

sections.heading: Silhouettes
sections.body:
- Crochet tops.
- Embroidered dresses and shirts.

design_implications: - Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.

sources.title: Kids spring/summer 2027 trends outlined by Future Snoops
